title: The Iron Downs' central grief (the Hundred Gallery) offered only a single action, 'bring the gallery down for good (might),' which turned out to be the burn resolution — no rest or bargain option ever appeared there, contradicting the region overview's promise that every hold's grief can be rested, bargained with, or burned.
